columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Persistent-agent memory needs explicit durable and transient commitment semantics
columns.title_zh: 持久 Agent Memory 需要显式区分 Durable 与 Transient 的承诺语义
columns.source_zh: LifeFuse-Mem 一手研究：用显式生命周期标签、独立 Stable/Transient Memory Component 与 Phase-aware Readout，降低临时信息覆盖长期记忆
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260915-006 after Skill 02 triage. LifeFuse-Mem exposes a bounded governance problem for persistent digital employees: transient context and durable knowledge cannot safely share identical write semantics, because short-lived observations may overwrite stable state and silently influence future work. The primary study separates stable and transient memory components, attaches lifecycle labels and uses phase-aware readout; the authors report reduced temporary overwrite on a controlled benchmark while remaining broadly competitive on two public long-memory benchmarks. The research question is therefore what temporal commitment a memory write carries, when transient evidence may be promoted to durable state, and what retrieval semantics preserve that distinction over long-running work. This is materially distinct from the September 8 migration object, which studied semantic portability across model/embedding upgrades, and the September 11 evidence-preservation object, which studied non-destructive semantic reorganization of already-stored observations; today's object isolates the write-time and read-time lifecycle boundary between temporary and durable state.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260915-006。LifeFuse-Mem 暴露了持久数字员工中的一个有界治理问题：Transient Context 与 Durable Knowledge 不能默认共享完全相同的写入语义，否则短期 Observation 可能覆盖稳定状态，并在未来工作中持续影响行为。该一手研究把 Stable 与 Transient 信息分离到不同 Memory Component，使用显式 Lifecycle Label 与 Phase-aware Readout；作者报告其在受控 Benchmark 上降低 Temporary Overwrite，并在两个公开 Long-memory Benchmark 上保持大体竞争力。因此，本日问题是：一次 Memory Write 应携带怎样的时间承诺，Transient Evidence 在什么条件下才可提升为 Durable State，以及 Retrieval 如何在长周期工作中保持这种区分。它与 9 月 8 日的 Memory Migration 对象实质不同，后者研究 Model/Embedding 升级后的语义可移植性；也不同于 9 月 11 日的 Evidence-preserving Memory 对象，后者研究已经写入的 Observation 如何在语义重组时避免被破坏。今天单独研究 Temporary 与 Durable State 的写入/读取生命周期边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify LifeFuse-Mem's lifecycle label definitions, stable/transient write policy, promotion or update rules, phase-aware readout, controlled anti-overwrite benchmark, the two public long-memory benchmarks, baselines, ablations, storage and latency costs, failure cases, and whether temporary information can still leak into durable behavior through retrieval or model context. It must not infer production memory truth or authorization guarantees from benchmark quality alone.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 LifeFuse-Mem 的 Lifecycle Label 定义、Stable/Transient Write Policy、Promotion/Update Rule、Phase-aware Readout、受控 Anti-overwrite Benchmark、两个公开 Long-memory Benchmark、Baseline、Ablation、存储与延迟成本、失败案例，以及 Temporary Information 是否仍可能经 Retrieval 或 Model Context 泄漏到 Durable Behavior；不得仅由 Benchmark Quality 推导生产 Memory Truth 或 Authorization Guarantee。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: No Selection. The only primary Industry Architecture signal, SIG-20260915-001, identifies a meaningful product-architecture mechanism: a managed long-running harness with durable sessions, context compaction, tool orchestration and parallel subagents above a selectable sandbox boundary. The research question is valid, but today's evidence is still one vendor's official public-beta announcement and does not independently establish the claimed architecture as a general mechanism or failure boundary. Under Skill 02's evidence-sufficiency and release-boundary rules, it remains a candidate rather than being promoted merely because the platform is new. The column is therefore explicitly closed with No Selection instead of filling a quota.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。本栏唯一主 Signal，SIG-20260915-001，确实揭示了一个有意义的产品架构机制：在可选择的 Sandbox Boundary 之上提供持久 Session、Context Compaction、Tool Orchestration 与并行 Subagent 的托管长周期 Harness。研究问题成立，但今天的证据仍只有一个厂商的官方 Public-beta Announcement，尚不能独立证明该架构具有一般性，也不能证明其 Failure Boundary。按照 Skill 02 的 Evidence Sufficiency 与 Release Boundary 规则，它应保留为 Candidate，而不能仅因为平台较新就提升。本栏因此显式以 No Selection 收口，不为填满名额而选弱对象。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260915-001 as a candidate for future comparison with another managed harness, self-hosted runtime, benchmark or incident that tests the separation between harness ownership and execution-environment ownership. Reading must perform no separate Industry Architecture Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260915-001 为 Candidate，等待未来与另一种 Managed Harness、Self-hosted Runtime、Benchmark 或 Incident 做比较，检验 Harness Ownership 与 Execution-environment Ownership 的分离边界。本轮 Reading 不得为 Industry Architecture 单独执行 Deep Reading。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Recovery architecture should measure the causal value of failure detection and retry before adding reflection machinery
columns.title_zh: Recovery Architecture 应先验证 Failure Detection 与 Retry 的因果价值，再增加复杂 Reflection 机制
columns.source_zh: LAST-CQ 一手研究：在 2,471 个真实数据库 Query、6 个 Backbone 与 Counterfactual Variant 上分离 Failure Detection、Retry、Feedback 与 Parallel Sampling 的恢复贡献
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260915-004 as the strongest Open-source Engineering research object. LAST-CQ does not merely report that retry helps; it uses counterfactual variants across 2,471 live-database queries and six backbones to isolate which loop component produces recovery. The reported result is that correction/retry drives most of the gain, replacing schema-grounded feedback with raw database errors changes little, and spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality; the framework recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation. The bounded engineering question is which recovery-loop components have demonstrated causal value and therefore deserve complexity, latency and token budget. This is distinct from replay-safety or checkpoint research: it evaluates whether the components inside an already-authorized recovery loop causally improve outcomes rather than whether a retry is permitted or state-consistent.
columns.reason_zh: 作为本日 Open-source Engineering 中证据最强的 Research Object，选自 SIG-20260915-004。LAST-CQ 并不是简单报告‘Retry 有用’，而是在 2,471 个真实数据库 Query、6 个 Backbone 与多组 Counterfactual Variant 上分离 Recovery Loop 中不同组件的贡献。论文报告：主要收益来自 Correction/Retry；把 Schema-grounded Feedback 换成原始数据库错误几乎不改变结果；把同等 Call Budget 用于 Parallel Sampling 反而降低质量；对 Single-pass 失败 Query 的恢复率为 91.7%。因此，边界清晰的工程问题是：Recovery Loop 中哪些组件已经显示出因果价值，值得承担额外复杂度、延迟与 Token Budget。它与 Replay-safety 或 Checkpoint 研究不同：这里研究的是在 Retry 已被允许且状态一致的前提下，Loop 内各组件是否真正提升结果，而不是 Retry 是否被授权或 Recovery State 是否一致。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify LAST-CQ's 2,471-query construction, live-database execution protocol, six backbones, single-pass baseline, correction/retry policy, raw-error versus schema-grounded feedback counterfactual, parallel-sampling budget match, 91.7% recovery calculation, statistical uncertainty, cost/latency accounting, failure categories and external-validity limits beyond text-to-SQL. It must separate causal evidence about recovery components from any claim that retry is universally safe or authorized.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 LAST-CQ 的 2,471 个 Query 构造、Live-database Execution Protocol、6 个 Backbone、Single-pass Baseline、Correction/Retry Policy、Raw-error 与 Schema-grounded Feedback 的 Counterfactual、Parallel-sampling Budget 对齐方式、91.7% Recovery 计算、统计不确定性、Cost/Latency Accounting、Failure Category，以及 Text-to-SQL 之外的 External-validity Boundary；必须把 Recovery Component 的因果证据与‘Retry 普遍安全或已获授权’的主张严格分开。
